strings.FFTS_EXPANSION_DESCRIPTION: Adds content from the 'Fortunes from the Scrapyard' mod to the game.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_TAKEOUT_PICKUP: Hits at close range trigger a random food effect: burn, movement speed, or regeneration.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_TAKEOUT_DESCRIPTION:
Every hit against an enemy within <style=cIsUtility>13m</style> activates the food indicated by your ring's color, then randomly selects the food for the next hit. <style=cIsUtility>No cooldown.</style>

<style=cIsDamage>Spicy Chicken</style> applies a burn dealing <style=cIsDamage>{0}%</style> <style=cStack>(+{1}% per stack)</style> TOTAL damage.
<style=cIsUtility>Slimy Noodles</style> grants <style=cIsUtility>{3}%</style> <style=cStack>(+{4}% per stack)</style> movement speed, decaying over <style=cIsUtility>{2} seconds</style>. Another noodle hit restores the full bonus and refreshes its duration.
<style=cIsHealing>Sticky Gyoza</style> grants <style=cIsHealing>{5} hp/s</style> <style=cStack>(+{6} hp/s per stack)</style> base health regeneration for <style=cIsUtility>{2} seconds</style>. Another gyoza hit refreshes its duration.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_TAKEOUT_LORE: This Orange Chicken recipe is made with boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces, dredged, and then fried until golden and crispy. It is a sweet orange sauce made with orange juice, vinegar, garlic, sugar, soy sauce, ginger, red chili flakes, and orange zest. It is both sweet and spicy and full of flavor.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_BROKENHEADPHONES_PICKUP: Chance to create a disorienting blast.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_BROKENHEADPHONES_DESCRIPTION: <style=cIsDamage>{0}%</style> chance to mark target on hit. Hitting marked targets will cause a <style=cIsDamage>shockwave</style>, dealing <style=cIsDamage>{1}%</style> <style=cStack>(+{2}% per stack)</style> TOTAL damage in a <style=cIsDamage>{3}m</style> <style=cStack>(+{4}m per stack)</style> radius.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_MULTITOOL_PICKUP: The next non-chest interactable triggers an additional time. Regenerates every stage.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_MULTITOOL_DESCRIPTION: The next <style=cIsUtility>non-chest</style> interactable used triggers <style=cIsUtility>an additional time</style>, and consumes this item. At the start of each stage, it regenerates.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_MULTITOOL_LORE:
'Multi Tool v2.0'
Tracking Number: ***350
Estimated Delivery: 01-09-2077
Shipping Method: Standard
Shipping Address: 280 Z St, Sunny Side, Triton
Shipping Details: 16-in-1 Multitool : Axe, Hammer, Claw, Pipe, Pliers, Wire Cutter, Knife, Saw, Serrated Knife, File, Flathead Screwdrivers, Phillips Screwdrivers, Whistle, Flint Fire Starter, Bottle Opener, and Laser Pointer.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_MULTITOOLCONSUMED_PICKUP: It is no longer useful. Regenerates next stage.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_MULTITOOLCONSUMED_DESCRIPTION: It is no longer useful. Regenerates next stage.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_LETHALINJECTION_PICKUP: Chance to inject enemies, amplifying damage over time and permanently increasing their execute threshold.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_LETHALINJECTION_DESCRIPTION: <style=cIsDamage>{0}%</style> chance to <style=cIsDamage>inject</style> an enemy on hit for <style=cIsDamage>{1}s</style>, causing them to take <style=cIsDamage>{4}x damage over time</style>. Each debuff stack <style=cIsHealth>permanently</style> increases the <style=cIsDamage>execute threshold</style> by <style=cIsDamage>{2}% <style=cStack>(+{3}% per stack)</style> of maximum health per second</style>.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_LETHALINJECTION_LORE:
Soldiers are given three simple things when they hit the battlefield: a uniform, a weapon, and a metal case. One to remind you of your duty, another to remind you of your strength, and the last to remind you of what happens when you fail.

The case is for the weak with no more sense of duty. Beats dying from the local wildlife, or worse.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_COUNTERFEITCURRENCY_PICKUP: Begin each stage with free purchases... <style=cIsHealth>BUT get cursed for those purchases.</style>
strings.FFTS_ITEM_COUNTERFEITCURRENCY_DESCRIPTIO: Begin each stage with <style=cIsDamage>{6}</style> <style=cStack>(+{7} per stack)</style> <style=cIsUtility>counterfeit</style> purchases. Purchases that you cannot afford use a <style=cIsUtility>counterfeit</style> purchase and lowers your <style=cIsHealth>health</style> by {0}/<style=cIsHealing>{1}</style>/<style=cIsHealth>{2}</style>% for the stage.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_COUNTERFEITCURRENCY_LORE:
The sound of slot machines around, the constant thrill of wasting your life savings yet again. It’s a problem, you know that. However, as you sit across from the chairman, those problems seem trivial...

"400 on red!" you exclaim just before the alarm begins to screech. It’s time to run. As the doors begin locking around you, doubt settles in. Where is the goddamn exit? Your mind is in disarray, yet you remain collected, standing in front of the judge, jury, and executioner of Triton's Reach.

"The exit is the least of your worries. 400, was it?"
strings.FFTS_ITEM_SPRAYCAN_PICKUP: High damage causes a <style=cIsDamage>graffiti explosion</style>. Recharges over time, and is usable <style=cIsDamage>{0}</style> times per stage.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_SPRAYCAN_DESCRIPTION: Hits that deal <style=cIsDamage>more than {2}% damage</style> also blast enemies with a <style=cIsDamage>graffiti explosion</style> dealing <style=cIsDamage>{3}%</style> TOTAL damage. Recharges every <style=cIsUtility>{1}</style> seconds. This item can be used <style=cIsUtility>{0}</style> <style=cStack>(+10 per stack)</style> times per stage.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_SPRAYCAN_LORE:
"The can normally goes pshhht, y’know? This one goes pshhhhhhhhhhhht till there’s no more paint." - [Redacted 1]
"What are you even saying?"- [Redacted 2]
"Yeah, they’re right though, cans do normally go pshhht." - [Redacted 3]
strings.FFTS_ITEM_FAULTYTURBO_PICKUP: Build up bonus movement speed while sprinting.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_FAULTYTURBO_DESCRIPTION: While sprinting, gain <style=cIsUtility>{2}%</style> <style=cStack>(+{3}% per stack)</style> <style=cIsUtility>movement speed</style> every second, up to <style=cIsUtility>{0}</style> <style=cStack>(+{1} per stack)</style> stacks.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_FAULTYTURBO_DESCRIPTION_OLD: While sprinting, gain <style=cIsUtility>{2}%</style> <style=cStack>(+{3}% per stack)</style> <style=cIsUtility>movement speed</style> every second up to <style=cIsUtility>{0}%</style> <style=cStack>(+{1}% per stack)</style> <style=cIsUtility>movement speed</style>.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_LOSTRECORD_PICKUP: Using skills with cooldowns lowers other skill cooldowns.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_LOSTRECORD_DESCRIPTION: Using a skill with a cooldown <style=cIsUtility>lowers the current cooldown of all other skills by {0}%</style> <style=cStack>(+{1}% per stack)</style>.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_DUCTTAPE_DESCRIPTION: When below <style=cIsHealth>{0}% health</style> <style=cIsHealing>healing is increased by {1}%</style> <style=cStack>(+{2}% per stack)</style>.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_POLYPORE_PICKUP: Debuffs periodically spread to nearby enemies, <style=cIsHealth>BUT the enemies they spread from are cleansed of all debuffs</style>.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_ROUGHRECEPTION_PICKUP: Primary skills are followed up with a swing.
strings.FFTS_ITEM_ROUGHRECEPTION_DESCRIPTION: Using your primary causes your <style=cIsDamage>feline friend</style> to swing for <style=cIsDamage>{0}%</style> <style=cStack>(+{1}% per stack)</style> damage.
